You should mix up your movement and focus on accuracy.

- 240hz+ display

- wireless mouse with 1ms delay
- consistent framerate as high as your PC can sustain (320+ in kovaak is essential)
- no frame buffering or v-sync

Special click-timing scenario designed to increase precision for static dots.  The targets vibrate slightly, so that a 'near miss' in a normal static dot scenario is more likely to actually miss.  However, the center of the target does not move enough to affected by the bot vibrating.  A new scoring system has also been introduced- kills reward 0.125 seconds to the challenge timer, each kill adds 1 to the final score, and misses subtract 0.25 from the final score.  The gun used has 4 bullets, and refunds 1 bullet on a hit.  Reloads take 3 seconds (so four misses = reload AND -1 kill to final score).  There is no accuracy penalty.

Cycle Strafe scenarios are scored by remaining time after killing 6 bots (long strafe, long strafe, mid strafe, mid strafe, fast strafe, fast strafe).  Every 1s of using MBS correctly applies 0.5s worth of time score back.  The last word in the scenario title refers to the player's intended dodging patterns to maximize MBS score.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND: Settings->Sounds->"MBS Change Now" to a sound you can hear over your hit sounds.

A single bot makes fast and sporadic strafes on a flat surface and continuously respawns after it's eliminated, all while the player navigates the space as they shoot. 

In this scenario, conditional distance travelled scoring is used and is capped to 1000. As long as you don't mirror every bot 100% of the time, you will reach the score cap. Other changes:
1. The map width is 118%.
2. Added target collision prevention.
3. Spawn probability in difficult places is now the same as in other places (previously it was 3 times lower).
4. Added lines on the wall to make it easier to understand where the targets are going to hit the wall.
5. Targets move in a straight line (left/right only) and more predictably.
6. Targets no longer strafe immediately after respawning.
7. Targets no longer slide on the wall.
8. Shooting the center of targets is no longer necessary for maximum accuracy (no weapon spread in accuracy scoring anymore).
9. Minor map changes.
10. Crouching allowed (46.15% speed, 50% height).

If you want to return your own theme in this scenario:
1. Open the game settings.
2. Go to the "Visuals" tab.
3. Mark the "Override Scenario Visuals" flag.

Note that this is not recommended because you will no longer see the lines on the walls.
